entries.tokenRhythmBalanceNote: Shows available CNY balance from the official account page. Sign in at tokenrhythm.studio. In browser DevTools, copy the account request Cookie from Network, or the tr_session value from Storage / Application. Save it below and enable this card. Cookies stay in the DSH credential store; replace them when expired.
entries.aliyunBalanceNote: Shows Alibaba Cloud China funds. RAM AccessKey needs bss:DescribeBillingAccount. The first two fields are required; Security Token is for STS. Secrets stay in the credential store.
entries.customBalanceConfigNote: Extract accepts paths, numbers and add/subtract/divide. Divide NewApi quota by 500000 for USD.
entries.customBalanceUrlHint: Supports HTTPS, local HTTP and /plugins/… paths that follow the current DSH port.
entries.customBalanceHttp: Allow non-loopback HTTP (plaintext credentials; requires the exact host:port in allowed hosts)
entries.workBuddyBalanceNote: The WorkBuddy2API preset reads remaining credits across active accounts using an admin X-Admin-Token, not a model API key. Set the actual address and port; replace the credential when it expires.
entries.customBalanceBodyNote: Blank sends no body; JSON text is saved and sent as entered. Content-Type defaults to application/json; headers can override it.
entries.customBalanceConvert: Convert USD balance to display currency
entries.customBalanceConvertNote: Uses the display rate and precision. Keep the source currency; other currencies and credits stay unchanged.
entries.barDirectionsHint: Each group of bars can independently choose its fill direction: "Remaining" starts full and drains with usage; "Used" starts empty and fills up.
entries.balanceBudgetCapHint: Leave empty to use API max_budget; if still missing, show full light-blue bar
entries.customBalanceHeadersVarNote: {{VAR_NAME}} reads a credential or environment variable. <ROUTE>_API_KEY uses an uppercase Provider ID with underscores, such as openai→OPENAI_API_KEY. Names can share a key.
entries.customBalanceAllowedHostsHint: When headers carry credentials only listed hosts are allowed; leave empty to allow with a warning. Protects keys when importing someone else's config.
entries.customBalanceCredentialsHint: Store the key for each {{VAR}} placeholder above (write-only: stored in the DSH credential store, never echoed back):
entries.customBalanceNoPlaceholders: No {{VAR}} placeholders in the headers yet — add e.g. "Authorization": "Bearer {{MY_API_KEY}}" and a credential input will appear here.
entries.goQuotaKeyLabel: OpenCode Go API key (optional; empty = auto-detect)
